s: Zeman veseder lishat matztzat hammitzva ubo y"z seipim: nahagu kol yisrael shello lalush hammatztzot shel mitzva ad achar chatzot hayyom beereb pesach shehu zeman haqrabat happesach, shemmitzvat matztza huqqesha lemitzvat happesach, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim yokluhu". Ulepi sheen hakkol beqiim bachatzot hayyom mammash, lepikak nakon lehamtin chatzi shaa achar chatzot hayyom, ki ken hayu mamtinim bishchitat happesach shello leshochoto ad leachar shesh umechetza:

Vekol zeh eno ella minhag lekattechilla, abal meiqqar haddin apillu matztzot mitzva shenneepu kamma chodashim lipne happesach — yakol latzet bahen yede chobato lekattechilla, lepi shello huqqesha matztzat mitzva lemitzvat pesach ella lizman akilatah bilbad, shetztzarik leoklah qodem chatzot hallayla kemo happesach sheeno neekal ella ad chatzot, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim yokluhu", huqqesha akilat matztza laakilat happesach, abal leinyan zeman asiyyatan lo huqqeshu kelal, veyakol leepotan mittechillat hashshana, vehu sheyyopeh otan leshem happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g. Abal im lo apaan leshem happesach — min hassetam lo nizhar yapeh mechametz bishat asiyyatan, lepikak hen asurin lekol yeme happesach:

Ubishat haddechaq maamidin al iqqar haddin, kegon otan sheopin matztzot vesholechin lemerchaqqim — muttarin leepot apillu kamma chodashim qodem happesach. Veken hamporshim miyyabbasha layyam kamma chodashim qodem happesach — opin matztzot qodem yetziatam mibbetam, abal shello bishat haddechaq en leshannot hamminhag:

Veim chal ereb pesach beshabbat — nohagin lalush beereb shabbat achar chatzot hayyom. Veyesh nohagin lalush bemotzae shabbat, dehaynu belel yom tob, venotenin taam leminhagam: lepi shechabiba mitzva bishatah. Veen rauy linhog ken, lepi shetztzarik lemaher haakila belel pesach miyyad biknisat hallayla kede shello yishnu hattinoqot kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"b, veim yitasseq bitchillat hallayla belishat hammatztzot vaapiyyatan — bevadday yishnu hattinoqot. Veod, shehaopeh matztzot beyom tob tzarik lehizzaher bekamma halakot: haek lehaprish challa mehen (shennitbaer besiman tn"z), vehaek lenaqqot kele hallisha mechametz hannidbaq bahen (sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t), veen hakkol beqiin bahalakot ellu veyabou lisrop hachalla beyom tob veligrod ulehadiach hakkeli al yede yisrael (ayyen siman tn"t). Veap bechol hammoed rauy linhog shello leepot matztzot, ella yopeh hakkol qodem happesach im epshar lo, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tn"g:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shehag' matztzot shel mitzva hen naasin meissaron echad qemach keen lachme toda, shehayu g' challot naasot meissaron echad, shehare hayu bah sheloshim challot shel matztza naasot measara esronim, nimtzeu shalosh challot leissaron, lepikak anu osin gam ken g' matztzot leissaron zeker lelachme toda, shehayyotze mibbet haasurin chayyab lehabi toda, veanu bepesach yatzanu mibbet haasurin mishshibud mitzrayim, lepikak anu osin zeker lelachme toda:

Umi sheyyesh lo bene bayit rabbim veen maspiq lo issaron echad — yakol lehosip al issaron beg' matztzot hallalu, dehaynu sheyyalush b' issot sheen bekol achat mehen yoter meissaron, veyaaseh shette issot, umishshettehen yaaseh g' matztzot, veim bekol achat mehen bipne atzmah en lah issaron meruvvach — yetzarep shettehen yachad al derek shennitbaer besiman tn"z veyaprish mehen challa, veachar kak yaaseh mehen g' matztzot. Veim eno yakol lehaprish mehen beodan issa mippene mehirut hammitasseqin bahen — yaaseh mehen g' matztzot veuga achat, veyopeh et kullan, uleachar haapiyya yetzorpem yachad bikli echad veyaprish min hauga al kullan. Abal mi sheen lo bene bayit merubbim — tob sheyyiqqach issaron meruvvach veyaaseh mimmennu g' matztzot veuga achat, veyachazor veyalush od issaron metzumtzam veyaaseh mimmennu g' matztzot letzorek lel sheni, uleachar sheyyopeh et kullam — yetzorpem bikli veyaprish min hauga al kullam:

Venohagin laasot bahen siman ezo mehen rishona veezo mehen sheniyya veezo mehen shelishit, shebbeharishona osin bah mitzva harishona, dehaynu birkat "hammotzi", shebberaka zo hi hammitzva harishona sheosin bammatztzot hallalu, ubashsheniyya osin hammitzva hashsheniyya, dehaynu birkat "al akilat matztza", ubashshelishit osin mitzva hashshelishit, dehaynu hakkerika im hammaror. Lepikak, keshemmannichin otan al haqqeara — yanniach otan gam ken al seder hazzeh: hashshelishit lematta, vehashsheniyya al gabbah, veharishona al gabbe hashsheniyya, kede shello yitztarek lehaabir al hammitzvot. Umikkol maqom, seder zeh eno meakkeb sheap im shinna kol sidran, shehinniach harishona lematta vehashsheniyya lemala vehashshelishit barishona — en bekak kelum bediabad:

Vehassimanim sheoseh bahen lo yaaseh otan kemin otiyyot al yede depus o beyadayv (mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman t"s, veod) shehare tzarik leshobram beyom tob, veyesh oserin lishbor uga sheyyesh bah kemin otiyyot ap al pi sheen mitkavven lemochqam ella leoklam beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"m, ella osin simanin hallalu al yede neqabim o charitzin, raq sheyyizaharu lemaher meod baasiyyatan, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"s ayyen sham:

Veyizzaher leepot harishona qodem hashsheniyya vehashsheniyya qodem hashshelishit, dehaynu sheyyaknisem lattannur zeh achar zeh, sheim yopeh otan bebat achat — lo hoil kelum bassimanim shennatan bahem, dekevan sheggemar asiyyatam hu bebat achat — en leachat qedima umaala al chabertah:

Hammatztza hashsheniyya tzerika lihyot yoter gedola meharishona vehashshelishit, lepi shemmimmenna tzarik kishne zetim lekol echad mibbene beto, kezayit echad lebirkat "al akilat matztza" ukezayit echad laapiqoman:

Veim neebda achat mimmatztzot hallalu — nakon leepot g' matztzot apillu beyom tob, kede sheyyihyeh lo g' matztzot hannaasot meissaron echad qemach keen lachme toda lepi minhag medinot ellu. Vaapillu im yesh lo shalosh matztzot acherot shennaasu min issaron echad — en lo liqqach otan, lepi sheyyesh lachosh bahen shemma naasu al yede qetannim, dekevan shebbishat asiyyatan lo haya dato alehen sheyyihyu matztzot mitzva — min hassetam lo nizhar bahem miqqetannim umishshear happesulin lehitasseq bematztzot mitzva, venimtza sheyyesh bahen sepeq pissul, lepikak i epshar liqqach otan lebirkat "al akilat matztza", sheakilatah hu min hattora, vesapeq shel tora lehachamir. (Abal muttar leekol mehen apiqoman o laasot mehen kerika), sheakila zo enah ella middibre soperim usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman ta"z:

Abal im nishbera achat mimmatztzot hallalu — en tzarik litroach veleepot od apillu adayin lo niknas lel yom tob, ella yiqqach hashshebura veyasim otah baemtza ben haelyona lattachtona, shehaemtzait enah tzerika lihyot shelema, shehare botzein mimmenna chatika achat laapiqoman qodem amirat hahaggada. Veap shellekattechilla hiddur mitzva hu shekkol hag' matztzot yihyu shelemot beshaa shemmebiin otan al hashshulchan, mikkol maqom en matrichin oto bishbil kak leepot od, vaapillu nishbera matztza hashshelishit ukesheyyasim otah baemtza vehashsheniyya yasim lematta, nimtza sheyyaaseh matztza hashshelishit mishsheniyya, vahare zeh kemoridah miqqedushshatah:

Veyesh nohagin leepot od g' matztzot meissaron echad veqorin otan matztzot sepeqot, kelomar shennaasu bishbil sapeq, shemma tachmitz o tobad echad mig' harishonot azay yiqqach g' matztzot hallalu. Abal im nishbera achat mehen, apillu nishbera hashshelishit veim yitten otah baemtza vehaemtzait lematta hare zeh kemoridah miqqedushshatah — ap al pi ken mutab lehoridah miqqedushshatah millidchot matztzot hallalu legamre veliqqach et hassepeqot, shehare i epshar lo lidchot et hashshebura bilbad veliqqach bimqomah matztza acheret mehassepeqot, kevan shello naasu meissaron echad:

Veyesh nohagin sheen opin g' sepeqot meissaron echad, ella meissaron echad opin d' matztzot, dehaynu g' matztzot mitzva usepeqa achat (veap al pi sheosin keen lachme toda ubelachme toda lo haya ella g' matztzot leissaron, mikkol maqom kevan shemmatztza harebiit enah naaset leshem matztzot mitzva ella bishbil sapeq — enah ola lacheshbon). Veken opin meissaron hashsheni letzorek lel b'. Ulepikak im nishbera hashshelishit shel matztzat mitzva en osin otah emtzait vehaemtzait lematta shello yoridenna miqqedushshatah, ella dochin legamre et hashshelishit hashshebura umesimin bimqomah et hassepeqa, shehare hi naaset meissaron echad im hammatztzot shel mitzva:
Vekol debarim ellu enan ella minhag uzerizut lekattechilla, abal meiqqar haddin en tzarik lizzaher kelal bekol debarim ellu shennitbaaru besiman zeh:

Hannohagin leepot matztza shel mitzva belel yom tob keshechal bemotzae shabbat — yizzaharu shello yopu az hassepeqot, shemma lo yitztarek lahem, venimtza oseh melaka shello letzorek yom tob. Veken yizzaharu shello yopeh belel yom tob rishon hammatztzot hatztzerikot lelel yom tob sheni:

Mi shellash issa beereb pesach samuk lachasheka velo hispiq leepotah ad shechasheka lel yom tob, im en dato leekol mimmenna beyom tob rishon ella beyom tob sheni o bechullo shel moed, sheyyesh lo matztzot letzorek yom tob rishon — asur lo leepotah beyom tob. Ap al pi sheim lo yopeh otah tachmitz veyaabor aleha be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", mikkol maqom lo yaaseh issur bayyadayim, ukesheyyopeh otah yaaseh issur bayyadayim. Lepikak en lo taqqana lehinnatzel meissur ella sheyyigmor bedato leekol beyom tob rishon kezayit mikkol matztza umatztza sheyyopeh meissa zo, o sheyyaakil liqtannim, veaz muttar lo leepotah. Veap al pi shezzo hi haarama, shehare eno tzarik kelal lammatztzot hallalu beyom tob rishon, veen bedato leekol mehen ella kede lehattir lo apiyyatan, ap al pi ken hittiru lo chakamim laasot ken, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"g vetaq"z, vehu sheyyeqayyem haaramato veyokal kezayit mikkol matztza umatztza beyom tob rishon, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:
